doc: P3.14 player-name decay rules, docs/08 §1.5 renderer-side effects (never the model). Stage 3: she occasionally types the name with a letter missing and corrects it. Stage 4: she sometimes adds -kun when affectionate and drops it when angry. Stage 5: the player's name tag in the chat log is replaced by hers for one line. The shadow-name greeting gate lives under 'shadow'. Read by game/llm/Corruption.gd; the in-code fallback DOCS_NAME_RULES holds the same values so a broken file degrades to the documented behaviour. Tuning chances here is retuning a documented effect — test_data_file_carries_the_docs_table pins the file to the fallback.
